scope: Synthetic Model ObjectStroke getters/setters -> native Drawing selection -> one GLV1 RedrawPen -> curved redrawLine/redrawEndPen source callbacks -> RTV1 AddPoint and complete vector. Raw source indices are matched ordinally against actual getter arrays; callback AddPoint ranges are measured from native entry traces. No SDK deserialization or paint output.

encoding.source_point_and_pressure_words: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; interpret as IEEE-754 f32 bits
encoding.native_xyz_words: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; native vector bytes decoded little-endian into f32 words
encoding.size_word: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; decoded from source getter byte encoding

provenance.capture_source: Hash-pinned MagicPen saved-caller runner, parameterized by this script. A Unicorn code hook is added immediately before ObjectDrawing::drawObjectStroke and removed immediately after it; only that invocation contributes to phase and callback observations. Wrapper SHA-256 uses a stable <FIXTURE_OUTPUT> placeholder. Each callback includes its raw source ordinal and its exact AddPoint half-open range/records.
